text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab League criticises U.S. Congress vote in favour of transferring U.S. embassy to Jerusalem.
- Iraq and Egypt review developments in northern Iraq.
- Arab lawyers call for a unified Arab stand to face Turkish aggression on Iraq.
- Egypt and Libya discuss setting up a free trade zone.
- Jordan concerned over Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- Egypt calls for the immediate withdrawal of Turkish troops from northern Iraq.
- Ship loaded with wheat arrives at Umm Qasr.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Article on what Arabs need to do to resist Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
